title: Good stem - just not for my 8 year old.
text: I love STEM. As a science geek married to another science geek I love stem. I love the lower age group stem for my son. My daughter is 8 and really has not enjoyed her past 3 stem projects as they are all building and engineering projects - she can code and loves technology and Biology. But these have not really held her interest. There was not much variety these past 3 months and they were all just a little too hard for an 8 year old. I think the Amazon categories may need to be a bit larger as the gap between 8 and 13 intellectually and mathematically is greater than in the lower stem activities.
label: neutral
